get.summary: List friends and pending friend requests

post.description: 204 also when the request was already sent. 409 when you are already friends or the user already sent you a request (accept it instead). 400 for yourself, 404 for an unknown user.
Accepts the request the given user sent you. Only the receiver can accept: 403 for the sender, 404 when there is no pending request between you.
Declines the request the given user sent you. Only the receiver can decline: 403 for the sender, 404 when there is no pending request between you.

delete.summary: Remove a friend or cancel a sent request
delete.description: 204 whether or not there was anything to remove, so a retry is harmless.

post.description: Validates the preferences (400), filters the venue database (422 when too few venues match), lets the AI combine the remaining venues into plans, and checks every plan against the database before returning 2 or 3 distinct plans. 502 when the AI is unavailable or returns fewer than 2 usable plans.

put.summary: Save a plan to the account
put.description: Idempotent: saving the same plan id again replaces it. Plan ids are per account, so another account saving the same id gets its own copy. The venues are looked up in the database (400 for an unknown venue); the body's plan id must match the URL. 401 when the account no longer exists, 409 when it is at its limit of saved plans.

delete.summary: Remove a plan from the account
delete.description: 204 whether or not the plan was saved, so a retry is harmless.

post.description: Returns the plan's public link, which anyone can open on the website without an account. Sharing an already shared plan returns the same link. 404 when the account has not saved the plan.

delete.description: The link stops working. Sharing the plan again gives a new link. 204 whether or not the plan was shared.

get.description: No account needed. 404 when the link is unknown or the owner stopped sharing it.

Case-insensitive match anywhere in the display name, at least 2 characters, up to 20 results, never including the signed-in user. Returns only ids and display names, never email addresses. Relation says whether you are friends or a request is pending.
